frames.headline: 29 COUNTRIES. ONE VISA.
frames.sub: Apply once. Travel the whole zone.
frames.body: A Schengen visa lets you move freely across 29 European countries. The hard part is not the travel. It is the file.

frames.headline: YOUR SCHENGEN FILE NEEDS
items: Hotel booked for every night of the stay
frames.footnote: Requirements vary by nationality and profile. We build the list around yours.

frames.headline: APPLY WHERE YOU SLEEP MOST.
frames.sub: Not where the slot is fastest.
frames.body: Your application belongs to the country where you spend the most nights. Multi-country trips are where this goes wrong.

frames.headline: IT ACTUALLY TAKES
items: File prepared and cross-checked before submission
You attend the appointment — we tell you exactly what to bring
Decision sits with the consulate, always
frames.footnote: Appointment in the agreed time, or a full refund. That is a promise about our work, not theirs.

frames.headline: TELL US YOUR DATES.
frames.body: Free consultation, no obligation. If your file is not ready we will say so before you pay anything.
